text.content:
An elder is defined as a vampire who has survived for at least 250 years, though age alone does not grant the title — strength, resources and cunning are all part of what it takes to sit at the elders' table. Elder characters are not meant for new, inexperienced or immature players: their enhanced abilities can unbalance a chronicle if handled without care, and playing one well takes more thought and preparation than an average vampire. This layer of rules assumes familiarity with the standard Mind's Eye Theatre character creation process; only the deltas specific to elder characters are covered here, following the same five-step structure (Inspiration, Attributes, Advantages, Last Touches, Spark of Life).

Step One: Inspiration

Choose clan, Nature and Demeanor exactly as in standard character creation. Elder concepts should account for how long the character has been a vampire, how unlife has changed her over the centuries, and how thoroughly her attitudes crystallized at the time of her Embrace. @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.SNuXttNqxzJ6uPXv]{Caitiff} (clanless) elders are possible but are frequently scorned by their clanned peers.

Step Two: Attributes

Unlike a standard vampire character, an elder's Attributes are prioritized as 10 Primary / 8 Secondary / 6 Tertiary Traits, rather than the standard priority spread. Choose Traits as normal within that priority split.

Step Three: Advantages

Elder characters begin with more of each Advantage category than a standard character:

  • Abilities: 8 Abilities (rather than the standard allotment).
  • Disciplines: 6 Disciplines.
  • Influences: 6 Influences.

Elders of sufficiently low Generation gain access to power that is otherwise unavailable at character creation: a character of the 8th generation or lower may purchase Master-level Discipline powers during character creation. Elders above 8th generation are restricted to Basic and Intermediate Discipline powers exactly as any other vampire, regardless of their age.

Step Four: Last Touches

Assign Blood Traits and Willpower Traits as normal for the character's Generation. Record @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference.JournalEntry.St7uVm2DqK4nRy8X]{Status} Traits as appropriate to the character's reputation and standing among the Kindred — elders are expected to have accumulated more @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference.JournalEntry.St7uVm2DqK4nRy8X]{Status} than younger vampires, reflecting centuries of reputation-building (see the Status rules for details on acquiring and spending Status Traits).

Elder characters choose two starting Beast Traits or Path Traits (rather than the standard single Trait), reflecting the greater strain centuries of unlife place on the Beast and on a character's grip on morality. @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} members must choose a Path of Enlightenment rather than Humanity, as normal. Choose Negative Traits as per the core rules.

Step Five: Spark of Life

Add narrative descriptions and any Extra Traits at the Storyteller's discretion, exactly as in standard character creation.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference.JournalEntry.9b2d10b4317f4b02]{Character Creation} (the core five-step process this guide builds on).
